name: Other free AI scenario tools
description: Collection of freely available AI-assisted tools (often LLM-powered web apps, prompt libraries, or open platforms) for generating future scenarios, trend extrapolation, and strategic foresight outside of dedicated commercial suites.
reputation: Growing category valued for accessibility and rapid ideation by individual futurists and small teams.
notes: Quality and consistency vary widely by underlying model; risk of hallucinated trends or bias. Best used as idea generators requiring human validation.
